commands.name: panel
commands.description: Ask a panel of Claude agents (model:effort each) one question
commands.output:
Usage: /panel [seats or preset] [rounds=N] [brief=name] [skills=dir] [as=name] -- <question>

Seats, space separated: model:effort[:contrarian][+skill]
  model        opus, sonnet, haiku, fable
  effort       low, medium, high, xhigh, max
  +skill       loads a skill into the seat: a folder under skills= or the "Default skill folders" setting, else a session skill by the name /skills shows; repeat for more
  :contrarian  the seat attacks the obvious answer instead of answering
  brief=name   every seat reviews what you name through that brief
  rounds=N     rounds, 1 to 5 (no rounds: 1); round 1 is independent, in each later round every seat
               reads the others and replies; 2 is usual; a round where no seat changes anything ends it
  skills=dir   folders of <skill>/SKILL.md for this run's +skill names, comma separated
  as=name      also saves this run's seats and options as a preset of that name

Presets (no seats: "quick")
deep built-in opus:xhigh opus:high sonnet:high
quick built-in sonnet:medium sonnet:low haiku:high
duo built-in opus:high sonnet:high
review built-in opus:xhigh sonnet:high opus:high:contrarian
  You have no saved presets yet.
  See yours:  /panel-preset list, or /panel-preset show <name> for one
  Save one:   /panel-preset save <name> <seats> [scope=project], or as=<name> on any run
  Remove one: /panel-preset delete <name> [scope=project]
  Presets save to ~/.claude/agent-panel/presets.json, for you in every project; scope=project saves to .claude/agent-panel/presets.json in this project, to share through git.

Briefs
  (none found)
  Add your own as .claude/agent-panel/briefs/<name>.md in the project or under your home folder.

Examples
  /panel -- Is the retry in the queue worker safe?
  /panel deep -- Should we split this table before or after the migration?
  /panel opus:xhigh sonnet:high opus:high:contrarian -- Should we split this table?
  /panel sonnet:high+laravel-php-standards opus:high -- Is OrderService idiomatic?
  /pane

commands.name: panel-preset
commands.description: Save, list and delete agent panel presets
commands.argumentHint: save <name> <seats> | list | show <name> | delete <name> | skills [filter] | help
commands.output:
Usage: /panel-preset save <name> <seats or presets> [brief=name] [rounds=N] [skills=dir[,dir]] [scope=project] [force]
       /panel-preset list
       /panel-preset show <name>
       /panel-preset delete <name> [scope=project]
       /panel-preset skills [filter]

A preset is a named set of seats: run it as /panel <name> -- <question> or /pingpong <name> -- <task>.
  save       writes to ~/.claude/agent-panel/presets.json; scope=project writes to .claude/agent-panel/presets.json in this project
  skills=    folders of <skill>/SKILL.md the preset's +skill names load from, ahead of the "Default skill folders" setting and the session's skills
  brief=     the brief /panel uses with this preset; brief= on the command still wins
  rounds=    under /panel the total rounds, the first independent; under /pingpong the challenge rounds; rounds= on the command still wins
  force      replaces a preset of the same name in that file
  skills     lists what the "Default skill folders" setting and your presets' folders offer

A project file cannot replace a built-in preset or carry skill folders. as=<name> on /panel or /pingpong saves the seats of a run.

Example
  /panel-preset save content-council skills=~/skills/marketing sonnet:high+ads+ad-creative sonnet:high+copywriting opus:high:contrarian+cro
  /panel content-council -- Critique the home page redesign

commands.name: pingpong
commands.description: Ping-pong plan with two Claude agents (model:effort each)
commands.output:
Usage: /pingpong [two seats or preset] [rounds=N] [skills=dir] [as=name] -- <task>

Two seats, space separated: model:effort[+skill]. The first challenges, the second integrates.
  model        opus, sonnet, haiku, fable
  effort       low, medium, high, xhigh, max
  +skill       loads a skill into the seat: a folder under skills= or the "Default skill folders" setting, else a session skill by the name /skills shows; repeat for more
  rounds=N     challenge rounds, 1 to 5 (no rounds: 1); a challenger with nothing material to raise ends them early
  skills=dir   folders of <skill>/SKILL.md for this run's +skill names, comma separated
  as=name      also saves this run's seats and options as a preset of that name

Two-seat presets (no seats: "duo")
duo built-in opus:high sonnet:high
  You have no saved presets yet.
  See yours:  /panel-preset list, or /panel-preset show <name> for one
  Save one:   /panel-preset save <name> <seats> [scope=project], or as=<name> on any run
  Remove one: /panel-preset delete <name> [scope=project]
  Presets save to ~/.claude/agent-panel/presets.json, for you in every project; scope=project saves to .claude/agent-panel/presets.json in this project, to share through git.

Examples

  /pingpong opus:xhigh sonnet:high rounds=2 -- Plan the billing migration

/panel-view opens the pane. /panel help covers question panels. Settings are under /config.

tools.name: panel
tools.description: Ask several read-only Claude subagents the same question independently, each at its own model and effort. Use when the user asks for an agent panel or several opinions. Write a self-contained question with the facts they need. Set rounds above 1 only when the user asks for a discussion or debate: every extra round runs every seat again, each reading the others and replying. Returns at once; the answers arrive later as a new message for you to synthesise.

tools.name: pingpong
tools.description: Ping-pong planning: two read-only Claude subagents each draft a plan, you merge them, then each round the first challenges the plan and the second integrates the supported corrections. Use when the user asks for ping-pong planning. Write a self-contained task brief. Returns at once; the drafts arrive later as a new message.

tools.name: pingpong_merge
tools.description: Hand the merged candidate plan of a ping-pong run back to its agents to start the challenge rounds.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: Record your synthesis of a finished agent panel, or your read of a finished ping-pong plan, on its page. Call it once, after checking the claims, when a run's results ask for it. Every text field takes plain sentences with inline Markdown.

tools.name: git
tools.description: Read-only git for agent-panel seats: status, diff, log, show or blame with its arguments as a list. No shell.
